meta.source: Coded from the published QP and mark scheme (1MA1_1H_2506). Derived metadata only — question numbers, marks and skill tags. No exam question text transcribed.
meta.note: Marks per part read from the question paper's own part totals and checked against the printed 80. Questions 4, 5 and 6 are the overlap questions shared with 1F (1F q22, q23, q24) and are tagged identically. Tagging judgements are recorded in coding_notes.

coding_notes: q3a (complete a table of values for a quadratic) tagged substitution ONLY, deliberately not the ['substitution','quadratic_functions'] pair used on the 1F paper. quadratic_functions credits factorising_quadratics and expanding_double_brackets through its prerequisite tree, none of which a student demonstrates by evaluating x^2 + x - 4 at six values. Parts (b) and (c) do need quadratic_functions and carry it.

q7a: pdftotext mangles the printed algebraic fraction beyond reconstruction, but the mark scheme's accepted answers fix the task as simplifying a fraction whose numerator has two terms down to a linear expression. Tagged simplifying_expressions rather than algebraic_fractions: the latter credits factorising_quadratics and expanding_double_brackets for a one-mark simplification. The taxonomy has no 'divide a polynomial by a monomial' node.

q14 (sum even vs product even for two of nine balls, without replacement) tagged combined_events + mutually_exclusive_events, NOT conditional_probability. The mark scheme's route is multiplying two dependent probabilities and adding disjoint cases; conditional_probability would additionally credit venn_diagrams, tree_diagrams and frequency_trees, none of which appear.
q11 tagged inverse_proportion + proportion_with_powers: the second is the closest node to 'proportional to the cube root of', which the taxonomy states only for integer powers.

q12b (estimate the area under a curve with three strips) tagged kinematic_graphs + area_of_a_trapezium; the mark scheme's main method is three trapezia, with a midpoint-rectangle method allowed as an alternative.
q12 uses two-level part numbering, (a)(i) and (a)(ii). Encoded as parts 'ai' and 'aii', giving item ids 12ai / 12aii — the first audit file in the set to need anything beyond a single letter.
